unit: Comment API and branch-feed identity boundary
source_state_before_client_red: Previously verified backend identity/schema changes were committed in dd06caa9; HTTP DTO/projection and client title matching were unchanged before the client RED.

environment.frontend: Installed repository dependencies; Vitest/jsdom; no Next generators or build in the live checkout
environment.backend: SDK 10.0.300; mocked repository/access/profile services; no database needed for query/DTO tests
environment.working_runtime: Preserved; no application restart, schema apply or live database operation

commands.name: frontend-final-green
commands.repeat_reason: Final source uses parsed timestamps and the latest-completion edge case was strengthened with fractional ISO precision.

red_properties: An older open subtask with the same title consumed the completed sibling metadata, leaving the done card without attribution.
Renamed identity-backed subtask could not find completion metadata by its new title.
Deleting one same-title subtask suppressed both completions and polling could not restore the surviving sibling attribution.
Comment-list query and serialized DTO lacked the persisted source identity.
final_properties: Additive optional nullable CommentDto.SourceSubtaskId projects as sourceSubtaskId; absent old JSON remains deserializable; regular/genesis/legacy entries remain null.
Completion metadata and optimistic suppression use only exact source identity; title is display text.
The latest loaded identity-backed completion is selected using Date.parse; different fractional ISO precision is covered.
Legacy absent/null identity is preserved without attribution guessing, even when only one current title matches.
Deleting a sibling does not reassign ambiguous legacy attribution to the remaining same-title card.
Live merge learns source identity when content and updatedAt have not changed.
Delete rollback restores the selected identity-backed completion while leaving another source intact.
Existing component keyboard/pointer delete, shortcuts, composer and failure checks still pass; no layout/motion/copy changes.

test_scope.initial_red_vs_final_note: Only the initial 3 UI and 2 query/DTO cases were executed red before the fix. Additional policy cases are not claimed as that original RED.

api_doc_delta: GET /collaboration/api/v1/comments/{taskId} comment items add optional nullable sourceSubtaskId; use for subtask activity association. Existing JSON readers/constructors remain compatible. Legacy completion displays the existing generic note with no inferred actor/time.
schema_delta: NONE beyond the separately verified backend AddSubtaskActivityIdentity migration
demo_delta: NONE; current sandbox does not materialize subtask lifecycle system comments
